name: PHerc0343P (no model at letter level)
summary: Native 8.64 µm / 116 keV surface volumes; reference = 2.215 µm new_canon map. Reader v2/V3 are scored only on their two held-out segments; d9v4C is shown but excluded (leak). Caveat: the main reference is the canonical 2 µm model's prediction, not ground truth; node R checks it against letters traced on an infrared photograph (an independent, camera-based reference).
headline: No held-out model reaches letter level (WEAK; seed42 FAIL), including Reader v2/V3 on their own held-out segments; the scan is inside the tolerated blur/noise range and a 4× finer scan of the same segment does not fix it, so the gap is scroll/ink-specific, not resolution.
